description: Business-intent policy types for the payments portal (illustrative). The derived_from chain is deliberate: every policy inherits an accountable owner and a written justification from the root type, and each leaf type adds only the properties that type is about.

forge.policies.Root.description: Base business-intent policy. Every derived policy must name an accountable business owner and carry the justification an auditor reads.

business_owner.description: Accountable owner for this business-intent policy.

justification.description: Why this policy exists, in business terms.

forge.policies.Availability.description: Availability / SLA intent for a path or component.

multi_region.description: Whether the path must survive a region loss.

forge.policies.Placement.description: Data-residency / placement intent for a component.

residency.description: Region the data must remain in.

allowed_regions.description: Regions the component may be placed in.
